summary: Tested Methodology page, landing links, and full Accept-Invite (professional) flow including tokenized invites. 1 clear frontend bug: after 'Request more info', the invite card is incorrectly removed from the pending list (backend still shows status=pending). All other flows (decline, conflict, accept, token valid/bad/wrong-email, expiry text, testids, mobile) work.

ui_bugs.issue: After submitting 'Request more information', the card is removed from accept-list. Per spec, request-info leaves status='pending' on the backend, so the card MUST remain in the list. Root cause: onDone() -> done(id) unconditionally filters the request out for every action, including 'request-info'. Fix: in InviteCard.act, only call onDone(q.id, data.status) when path !== 'request-info' (or in done(), keep the request when returned status === 'pending' and just clear the panel).

issues: 2px horizontal overflow (very minor). Likely a stray full-width child; document.documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth = 2. Not user-visible but worth a quick audit.

action_items: Fix Request-more-info card removal: don't remove the pending card from accept-list after info submission (see AcceptInvite.jsx line ~42-45 and done()).

critical_code_review_comments: AcceptInvite.done(id) unconditionally removes the request; it ignores the status returned by the backend. Prefer status-aware update: keep pending, remove on declined/declined_conflict/prepared.
InviteCard uses navigate() only on 'prepare' success — good. But mixed toast text and control-flow inside one act() function could be split for clarity.

rca of the issue: Request-more-info UI bug RCA: In /app/frontend/src/pages/AcceptInvite.jsx, InviteCard.act calls onDone(q.id, data.status) for every non-'prepare' path. AcceptInvite.done ignores the passed status and always removes the request via setRequests(rs => rs.filter(q => q.id !== id)). Backend correctly keeps status='pending' with events[-1].type='info_requested' (verified with test_request_info_keeps_pending). Reproduction: log in as approved pro with a pending request -> /accept-invite -> click info-btn -> type message -> submit -> card disappears; refreshing /accept-invite shows the request is back (still pending). Mitigation: change done(id, status) to only remove when status !== 'pending'; alternatively skip onDone for the 'request-info' path and just call setMode(null).
